stories.headline: Diablo IV keeps anniversary bosses permanently as Season 16 arrives December 1
stories.summary: Season of Tyrael’s Gambit starts on December 1 at 18:30. Blizzard is adding a paired Reaper boss encounter, new War Plans progression options and Horadric items. The Prime Evil Council in Uber Tristram, Moophisto, the Diablo world boss and several legacy items will remain available in both Seasonal and Eternal realms after the current season ends. Patch 3.3.0 pre-download begins November 30 at 19:00 on Battle.net and consoles.

stories.headline: Nvidia GeForce 621.40 addresses the excessive SSD writes bug
stories.summary: Nvidia released a new Game Ready driver on November 24 whose official release notes list a fix for excessive background writes to its log file. Early user testing reported by PC Gamer suggests the new version succeeds where the previous 621.35 hotfix failed. The release is available for Windows 10 and 11.

stories.headline: Arctic Drive launches in Early Access on PC
stories.summary: The first-person survival road trip is now available in Steam Early Access, as confirmed by its store page. Explore a procedurally generated frozen wilderness alone or with up to three friends, scavenging fuel, food and vehicle parts. Customizable off-road vehicles and trailers double as mobile shelters against blizzards and freezing temperatures.

stories.headline: Athelan Battlegrounds launches as a free-to-play tactics game
stories.summary: The two-person indie team's competitive turn-based tactics game is now available on Steam. Players assemble champion teams for strategic PvP matches, with positioning and ability cooldowns determining the outcome. The developers promise cosmetic-only purchases and no pay-to-win mechanics. The game also features a custom puzzle editor.

stories.headline: Gravity Well enters hibernation without releasing its first game
stories.summary: The independent studio founded in 2020 by former Apex Legends developers Drew McCoy and Jon Shiring has stopped active operations after failing to secure replacement funding. More than 40 employees were laid off in October. The studio says it still believes in its unreleased game and is inviting potential funding partners to get in touch.

stories.headline: Exoprimal will shut down permanently on September 30, 2027
stories.summary: Capcom has confirmed that its online dinosaur action game will become unplayable on September 30, 2027 at 05:00. Sales of premium Survival Pass tiers have already ended. The base game and other downloadable content will be removed from stores on March 31, 2027 at 03:00, but existing owners can continue downloading and playing the game until the servers close.

stories.headline: Cyberpunk 2 development team grows to 199, with 320 planned by late 2027
stories.summary: CD Projekt Red's latest financial results show that the sequel's development team grew from 184 in July to 199 at the end of October. The studio aims to reach about 200 developers by the end of 2026 and 320 by the end of 2027. Management says development is progressing well, but has not provided a date for the transition into full production or a release date.

stories.headline: Terminus: Day Zero is out now as a free PC survival adventure
stories.summary: Longplay Studios has released a short, standalone zombie survival adventure for Windows. Players guide Daisy through the first day of an outbreak, relying on hiding, closing doors and escaping rather than fighting. The developer estimates a playthrough at about 30 minutes. The complete game is free, not a demo.

stories.headline: Proton 11.0-3 adds 15 playable titles and extensive Linux gaming fixes
stories.summary: Valve's November 24 release of its Windows game compatibility layer lists 15 newly playable titles. It also resolves a range of controller, audio, rendering and launcher problems, restores compatibility lost in earlier Proton 11 builds and adds early support for 32-bit OpenXR. Several fixes target Steam Deck and Steam Frame behavior.

stories.headline: Hollow Knight: Silksong expansion update scheduled for November 27
stories.summary: Team Cherry will host a Cherry Time presentation on November 27, with an update on its Sea of Sorrow expansion alongside other announcements. The expansion is planned as a free update for owners of the base game, with new areas and bosses. Its exact release date has not been confirmed.

stories.headline: The Witcher 4 gets a Sony marketing agreement as CD Projekt targets 2028
stories.summary: CD Projekt Red disclosed a partnership with Sony Interactive Entertainment during its latest earnings report. The agreement covers the upcoming game's marketing campaign as well as the presence of the company's games on PlayStation and PlayStation Plus. It does not establish platform exclusivity for The Witcher 4. The game remains on track for its planned 2028 launch.

stories.headline: Atari Homebrew Awards cancelled after eight years amid AI judging concerns
stories.summary: The organizer of the annual retro game development awards has cancelled the event after struggling to establish fair eligibility rules for AI-assisted entries. The host said prohibiting all AI use would exclude some experienced developers, while allowing it would make it difficult to distinguish human programming from generated games. The possibility of a future return remains open.
